searchKeyword.title: Search Keyword
searchKeyword.description: Keyword to search on Mercari (e.g. CBR250RR, iPhone 15, 腕時計)

maxItems.title: Max Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of items to scrape (default 100)

maxPages.title: Max Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of result pages to crawl (default 10, ~120 items/page)

priceMin.title: Min Price (JPY)
priceMin.description: Minimum price filter in JPY (0 = no limit)

priceMax.title: Max Price (JPY)
priceMax.description: Maximum price filter in JPY (0 = no limit)

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: IMPORTANT: Mercari works best WITHOUT proxy. Apify auto-proxy causes timeouts. Leave default (disabled) unless you have residential proxies.
